items.source:
Spring MultipartHttpServletRequest adapter, wrapping a Servlet HttpServletRequest
and its Part objects. Parameters get exposed through the native request's getParameter
methods - without any custom processing on our side.
items.translation: Spring MultipartHttpServletRequest 适配器，封装了 Servlet HttpServletRequest 及其 Part 对象。参数通过原生请求的 getParameter 方法暴露——无需我们进行任何自定义处理。

items.source:

items.source:
If the underlying implementation supports access to part headers,
then all headers are returned. Otherwise, for example, for a file upload, the
returned headers may expose a 'Content-Type' if available.
items.translation: 如果底层实现支持访问部分头信息，则返回所有头信息。否则，例如对于文件上传，返回的头信息可能会在可用时暴露“Content-Type"。
